vpn.meaning: The transmission.vpn object, with missing declared settings defaulted to null; other stored VPN properties are preserved.

provider.meaning: Stored VPN provider, or null when absent; existing values are not type-validated here.

protocol.meaning: Stored VPN protocol, or null when absent; existing values are not type-validated here.

region.meaning: Stored VPN region, or null when absent; existing values are not type-validated here.

dip.meaning: Stored dedicated IP setting, or null when absent; existing values are not type-validated here.

dns.meaning: Stored VPN DNS setting, or null when absent; existing values are not type-validated here.

rescan.meaning: Stored transmission rescan setting or its null default; an existing value is not type-validated here.

command.meaning: Command named on a handler refusal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal handler outcomes, with none on success.
